description: Move a task to a DIFFERENT file, preserving its user-visible id token (🆔/id::). An inline task's line relocates into to_file (under header when given, created if absent); a TaskNotes task's whole file relocates (to_file may be a directory — the basename is appended, with a bounded collision suffix). The corpus task_id is derived from the vault-relative PATH, so a move ALWAYS re-mints it — the response's id field is the NEW id, id_rekeyed is true, and source_path/destination_path report the relocation. Children that link to the task re-resolve on the next scan. Chain if_hash from get_task for optimistic concurrency.

dest_if_hash.description:
Destination-side compare-and-swap for an inline move: the
destination file's content-hash must equal this or the move is
refused (guards a concurrent edit to the DESTINATION between read
and write). Omit to auto-guard against the destination as read at
move time. Chain from `get_task` on the destination's existing
content when you want to declare it explicitly.

header.description:
For an inline move, insert the line under this markdown header in
the destination file (created if absent). Ignored for TaskNotes.

to_file.description:
Destination file (vault-relative). For a TaskNotes task this may
also be an existing directory — the file's basename is appended.

name: move_task
